name: Blair County, PA
findings: Blair County has 475 nonprofit organizations. 196 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 154 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Blair County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 9 community organizations here list membership, compared with about 2 in similar places of this size.
